news.headline: Anthropic IPO: Why Wall Street is betting big on Claude AI maker
news.summary: Anthropic is preparing for a blockbuster IPO that could value the Claude AI maker at up to $1.6 trillion. Strong investor demand, strategic stakes held by Amazon and Google, and bullish analyst forecasts are driving interest, although governance and profitability risks remain.

news.headline: Max Healthcare among 10 Nifty stocks rallied up to 22% in 1 month. Did you miss the rally?
news.summary: Nifty has surged impressively, claiming the title of the top-performing major equity market lately. Max Healthcare Institute reported a striking gain of almost 22% over the past month. InterGlobe Aviation and Mahindra & Mahindra followed suit with increases of approximately 20% and 17% respectively. The State Bank of India, a prominent public-sector entity, saw an uplift of about 15% as well.

Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
news.summary: The Indian rupee closed almost flat after peaking at a seven-month high during early trading on Wednesday. Robust foreign investments in local stocks provided a boost, but a stronger dollar capped further gains. The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

news.headline: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
news.summary: The government is reviewing proposals to cut securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% while raising levies on derivatives to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation. Officials are also considering a reduction in long-term capital gains tax. The recommendations will be presented to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027.

news.summary: Five Nifty500 stocks gained over 3% and closed above their respective 200-day moving averages on November 17, according to StockEdge’s technical scan, signalling a potential shift in their broader price trends.

SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
news.summary: SpiceJet's board of directors announced a fundraising plan to raise up to Rs 5,500 crore. The airline's shares have surged significantly, hitting the upper circuit for six consecutive sessions. Flight cancellations and operational disruptions have caused significant challenges for SpiceJet in recent days. The airline is focusing on rebuilding capacity and ensuring operational reliability going forward. The fundraising aims to strengthen its financial position and support fleet expansion efforts.

news.headline: How Ashish Kacholia, Radhakishan Damani, Madhusudan Kela and other ace investors reshuffled their portfolios in Q2
news.summary: Mukul Agrawal, Akash Bhanshali and Ashish Kacholia emerge as the biggest portfolio gainers among prominent individual investors in the September quarter. Meanwhile, Radhakishan Damani records the steepest decline. The analysis examines their portfolio values, top stock holdings and changes in shareholding across listed companies.
